quote: We test eight state-of-the-art chat-optimized LLMs on four different tasks requiring different levels of temporal and/or geographical knowledge
We present GEOTEMP, the first probing dataset specifically designed to evaluate the geotemporal knowledge of LLMs.
outputs: The models generate time and date responses to geotemporal questions, which are evaluated for correctness.

quote: We use a custom matching algorithm based on regex patterns to extract the time and date from the model responses

We use a custom matching algorithm based on regex patterns to extract the time and date from the model responses... Our regex evaluator achieves an accuracy of at least 98% for each model on the test set portion of the annotated subset.

We develop and test the regex evaluator in two steps. First, we ask two independent annotators to evaluate a sample of 3,600 model responses for their correctness (true / false) compared to the gold answers. Second, we split this data 50:50 into a development set, for constructing and optimizing regex patterns and a test set for evaluation.
We ask two independent annotators to evaluate a sample of 3,600 model responses for their correctness (true / false) compared to the gold answers

We ask two independent annotators to evaluate a sample of 3,600 model responses for their correctness (true / false) compared to the gold answers. Both annotators are fluent in English and are familiar with the task at hand.
We have two independent human annotators label this set of answers for their correctness with regard to the target answer given by the pytz package.
guideline: Annotators judged correctness of the model's response against the gold answer, with specific attention to ensuring the response matched the correct time at the respective location
Annotators label each model response as correct or incorrect by comparing it to the gold-standard answer.
The annotators were instructed that the model must respond with the correct time at the respective location, even if converting to UTC is factually correct.
